title: Which Trucks Last the Longest? The 2026 Ranking (250,000 Miles)
description:
Only one truck in the whole study has a better than three in ten chance of reaching two hundred fifty thousand miles. The average pickup has just eleven percent. And a truck that was number ten in the earlier edition we could read just jumped to number one. This is the twenty twenty-six ranking of the trucks most likely to last, with the real numbers, and the one warning that every list leaves out.
